corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the triangular loop of ዓ (ዘጸፍዓከ, from the Ge'ez root ጸፍዐ as seen in L14 ወይጸፍዕዎ), which was misread as አ.

corrections.old_text: ፩ ማር ፲፭ ፩ ዮሐ ፲፰ ፳፰ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ፷ ማር ፲፭ ፩ ዮሐ ፲፰ ፳፰ ።
corrections.reason: The first numeral on the line is ፷ (60, completing the reference ማቴ ፳፮ ፷), visually distinct from the ፩ following ማር ፲፭.
The final character on the line is 7th-order ኮ (with the top-right vowel loop), joining with ሙ on L34 to form the Ge'ez verb with object suffix የሀውኮሙ ('he stirs them up').
Both the printed glyph and standard Ge'ez orthography for this verb (from መሀረ) use 6th-order ህ (ወይሜህር) rather than ሕ.
